summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K on July 10, 2026, reporting its unaudited consolidated revenue for June 2026 and the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing announces record monthly and quarterly revenue since 2014, driven by AI-related demand. Revenue for June 2026 was NT$2,538.4 million (US$79.7 million), up 37.2% year-over-year, and for Q2 2026 was NT$7,383.1 million (US$231.8 million), up 28.7% year-over-year. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is equivalent to a domestic issuer's 8-K for earnings disclosure. There are no deal terms or corporate events to analyze.
